textBox.richText: John and Sharon - Garden of the Gods Club

Our wedding at the Garden of the Gods Club was perfect. After our first meeting with you, Sharon and I knew we were in good hands. Your flexibility and advice during the setting up the ceremony and creating our vows took a lot of stress off our plate and contributed to such a great day. I would like to say thank you for all your effort and advice, and helping in creating what was a perfect day for Sharon and I.
